The current text is [[Eventually You'll Lose (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 7, file created 17 June 2023: “USED: If The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone on table, ▲ Skywalker Hut or Jar Jar. LOST: If opponent's card was just stacked on Credits Will Do Fine, for remainder of turn, your Force drains may not be reduced.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Eventually You'll Lose (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Eventually You’ll Lose”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Eventually You'll Lose (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Eventually You'll Lose]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Eventually You'll Lose (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-e02f932">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eventuallyyoulllose.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/eventuallyyoulllose.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b e02f932] “LS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “If Podrace Arena on table, ▲ Skywalker Hut, Amidala, or Jar Jar. OR During your control phase, if you have won a Podrace and [Tatooine] Anakin is present at a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force for each [Dark Side] at that site.”<ref name="cj-4a981d6">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4a981d6 swccg-card-json commit 4a981d6] “Light - Tweak Set 2026” (15 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The card became a Used Interrupt (it was a Used or Lost Interrupt). The USED option’s condition “If The Hyperdrive Generator’s Gone on table” became “If Podrace Arena on table” and Amidala was added to the cards it may ▲ (take into hand from Reserve Deck); the LOST option (Credits Will Do Fine, Force drains may not be reduced) was replaced by “OR During your control phase, if you have won a Podrace and [Tatooine] Anakin is present at a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force for each [Dark Side] at that site.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
